prompts.question: Does the business have a public profile on Saramin with conflicting representative, establishment date, headcount, or registered address details?
prompts.why_it_matters: Saramin links corporate data to National Pension Service records; outdated representative or office details create conflicting public profiles for prospective hires and commercial partners.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Google for '<business name>' site:saramin.co.kr/zf_user/company-info/view and inspect the indexed company profile card.
prompts.found_when: A company profile is indexed displaying a representative name, establishment year, employee count, or registered headquarters address that contradicts what the business currently displays.
prompts.not_found_when: No Saramin company profile page is indexed, or the listed representative, address, and founding date match current business records.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The business name is shared by multiple unrelated entities across South Korea, or Saramin returns a generic index redirect.

prompts.question: Has the Ministry of Employment and Labor publicly blacklisted the business as a habitual wage arrears defaulter under the Labor Standards Act?
prompts.why_it_matters: Inclusion on the government's wage defaulter blacklist carries severe public reputational damage, commercial contract disqualification, and government loan restrictions.

source.name: Ministry of Employment and Labor Wage Defaulter Public Disclosure

prompts.how_to_query: Open the URL with the business name and inspect the table: if listed, it outputs the business name, CEO name, industry, registered address, and overdue wage amount.
prompts.found_when: The business appears in the table with a confirmed match on business name and location, citing specific delinquent wage amounts and the public disclosure cycle.
prompts.not_found_when: The table displays '데이터가 존재하지 않습니다.' (Data does not exist), confirming no public wage arrears disclosure.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The MOEL portal returns a network timeout or connection reset, or multiple distinct businesses share the exact common trade name in the same municipality.

prompts.question: Has the Korea Fair Trade Commission published a formal corrective order, warning, or fine against the business for unfair trade or deceptive advertising?
prompts.why_it_matters: Published FTC decision documents (의결서) disclose regulatory violations such as deceptive online sales, unfair subcontracting, or false advertising that clients and vendors inspect.

source.name: Korea Fair Trade Commission Online Case Processing System

prompts.how_to_query: Search Google for '<business name>' site:case.ftc.go.kr and read the case resolution documents or decision summaries.
prompts.found_when: An official FTC decision or warning document names the business as the respondent (피심인) and orders corrective action, penalty surcharges, or formal warnings.
prompts.not_found_when: No decision or case document is found referencing the company on the KFTC case system.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The query returns general regulatory notices without naming the specific company, or the case system site search is not indexed for recent decisions.

prompts.question: Does the business hold an active or expired INNO-BIZ Technology Innovation SME certification that is missing from its public marketing?
prompts.why_it_matters: Inno-Biz certification confers valuable procurement incentives, tax deductions, and preferential credit guarantee benefits that expired or unpublicized credentials fail to leverage.

source.name: INNO-BIZ Technology Innovation Association SME Registry

prompts.how_to_query: Open the query URL and inspect the table for company name, CEO name, region, industry sector, and certification expiry date (이노비즈만료일).
prompts.found_when: The company is listed with valid or expired Inno-Biz status, showing the official expiry date, sector, and representative.
prompts.not_found_when: The table returns empty or pagination displays 0 results for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The Inno-Biz ASP server is temporarily unreachable or the business operates under a newly changed corporate name not updated in the registry.

prompts.question: Does the business have an international B2B directory profile on Kompass Korea with conflicting export details, address, or phone number?
prompts.why_it_matters: International trade directories like Kompass often retain stale contact telephone numbers and outdated company management names seen by overseas buyers.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Google for '<business name>' site:kr.kompass.com/c/ and check the profile card for address, phone number, executive personnel, and product descriptions.
prompts.found_when: An indexed company profile lists obsolete phone numbers, previous office addresses, or former executives no longer associated with the business.
prompts.not_found_when: No profile page exists on kr.kompass.com/c/ for the business, or all listed contact info aligns with the company's verified details.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company name matches multiple disparate manufacturers or suppliers, or the Kompass page requires registration to view full contact numbers.

prompts.applies_when: companies with tech, creative, or corporate hiring presence
prompts.question: Does the business appear on Wanted with conflicting office location, founding date, or corporate profile details?
prompts.why_it_matters: Wanted company pages display corporate headquarters addresses, business scale, and hiring profiles that misinform candidates and B2B partners when left unmanaged.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Google for '<business name>' site:wanted.co.kr/company and inspect the company profile overview.
prompts.found_when: An indexed Wanted company page presents outdated company headquarters addresses, obsolete founding dates, or misstated corporate scale.
prompts.not_found_when: No company profile is indexed on wanted.co.kr/company, or the details match current public statements.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company name is ambiguous or matches unrelated software or agency entities.

sources_rejected.name: Supreme Court of Korea Internet Registry Office (인터넷등기소)
sources_rejected.why: Official corporate registration certificates (법인 등기부등본) require viewing fees (700 KRW), Korean proprietary security plugins (AnySign4PC), and session-gated form posts; cannot be queried free by open URL.

sources_rejected.name: National Tax Service HomeTax (국세청 홈택스)
sources_rejected.why: Business registration status check (사업자등록상태조회) requires a 10-digit business registration number (which the automated system does not have), digital certificates, and encrypted AJAX POST requests with session tokens.

sources_rejected.name: Financial Supervisory Service DART (전자공시시스템)
sources_rejected.why: Public disclosure search is restricted to external audit corporations (외감법인) and listed companies; web interface uses internal receipt IDs (rcpNo) rather than GET company name URLs, and OpenDART API requires private 40-character API key registration.

sources_rejected.name: KIPRIS Trademark Register (특허정보넷 키프리스)
sources_rejected.why: Web search interface relies on POST form submission and session state cookies with dynamic JavaScript rendering; direct GET URL parameter queries redirect to home, and automated access is restricted to the KIPRIS Plus REST API requiring private API keys.

sources_rejected.name: Republic of Korea Electronic Gazette (대한민국 전자관보)
sources_rejected.why: The electronic gazette search is implemented as a single-page application (SPA) submitting POST-based JSON API payloads without deep GET query string links.

sources_rejected.name: Fair Trade Commission E-Commerce Vendor Search (공정거래위원회 통신판매사업자조회)
sources_rejected.why: The public verification popup endpoint (bizCommPop.do) strictly requires a valid business registration number (wrkr_no), and the main portal list search (bizCommList.do) uses CSRF-protected form submissions.

sources_rejected.name: Public Procurement Service Nara Marketplace Disqualified Contractor Search (조달청 나라장터 부정당업자 제재정보)
sources_rejected.why: Hosted on non-standard port 8101 (g2b.go.kr:8101) with restricted external network routing and internal form-post session tokens.

sources_rejected.name: KoDATA / CRETOP Corporate Intelligence (한국평가데이터 크레탑)
sources_rejected.why: Commercial credit rating platform that requires paid corporate membership subscriptions and login authentication to view company profiles and financial ratings.

sources_rejected.name: Korea Yellow Pages (한국옐로우페이지)
sources_rejected.why: Protects all page requests with an automated client-side JavaScript challenge and cookie wall (CUPID AES challenge) that blocks automated HTTP fetchers.
